title: La vecina que me riega las plantas
goal: a describir a personas y cosas con who, which y that

ex.t: My best friend is the person who knows me best.
ex.es: Mi mejor amiga es la persona que mejor me conoce.

ex.t: I've got a neighbour who waters my plants.
ex.es: Tengo una vecina que me riega las plantas.

ex.t: She's an old colleague who lives in Leeds now.
ex.es: Es una antigua compañera de trabajo que ahora vive en Leeds.

ex.t: We've got relatives who live in Argentina.
ex.es: Tenemos familiares que viven en Argentina.

ex.t: My in-laws are coming for lunch on Sunday.
ex.es: Mis suegros vienen a comer el domingo.

ex.t: A stranger helped me with my suitcase.
ex.es: Un desconocido me ayudó con la maleta.

ex.t: She's a childhood friend who still lives in the village.
ex.es: Es una amiga de la infancia que sigue viviendo en el pueblo.

ex.t: I'm the godmother of my friend's daughter.
ex.es: Soy la madrina de la hija de mi amiga.

pron.title: La w de who, which y where
pron.tip: Who se dice «ju», ¡la w no suena! En which y where sí: labios redondos como para silbar, «uich», «uea».

exercises.q: My best friend is a woman ___ always tells the truth.
I've lost the scarf ___ my sister knitted for me.
exercises.why: Una bufanda es una cosa: which (o that).

exercises.q: A stranger ___ was on the bus helped me.
exercises.why: Un desconocido es una persona: who.

exercises.q: The colleague who ___ me most is retiring.
exercises.why: Who ya es el sujeto: no se repite she.

exercises.q: My in-laws have got a dog ___ barks all night.
exercises.es: Mis suegros tienen un perro que ladra toda la noche.

exercises.q: I have relatives ___ live in Argentina.
exercises.es: Tengo familiares que viven en Argentina.

exercises.q: This is the ring ___ my godmother gave me.
exercises.es: Este es el anillo que me regaló mi madrina.
exercises.why: Un anillo es una cosa: that o which.

exercises.q: My neighbour is a man which loves gardening.
exercises.why: Un hombre es una persona: who.

exercises.q: The present who you sent me was perfect.
exercises.why: Un regalo es una cosa: that (o which).

exercises.q: I have a childhood friend. She is a doctor now.
answer: I have a childhood friend who is a doctor now.
I've got a childhood friend who is a doctor now.
I have a childhood friend who's a doctor now.

exercises.q: I love the cardigan. You gave it to me.
answer: I love the cardigan which you gave me.
I love the cardigan which you gave to me.
exercises.why: Which sustituye a it: no lo repitas.

exercises.es: Tengo una vecina que me riega las plantas
exercises.answer: I have a neighbour who waters my plants

exercises.q: Mi mejor amiga es una mujer que siempre me escucha.
answer: My best friend is a woman who always listens to me.
My best friend is a woman that always listens to me.
exercises.why: Una mujer que… = a woman who…

exercises.context: Tu amiga te pregunta quién es el señor que te saluda por la calle. Es un compañero de trabajo de tu marido.
options: He's a man who works with my husband.
He's a man which works with my husband.
He's a man who he works with my husband.
exercises.answer: He's a man who works with my husband.
exercises.why: Persona: who, y sin repetir he.
Persona → who; cosa → which / that; lugar → where.

exercises.t: She's the friend who always makes me laugh.
exercises.es: Es la amiga que siempre me hace reír.

dialog.title: ¿Quién es quién?
dialog.setting: En una barbacoa en un jardín de San Francisco; Yolanda no conoce a casi nadie

lines.t: Do you know everyone here, Yolanda?
lines.es: ¿Conoces a todo el mundo aquí, Yolanda?

lines.t: Not really. Who's the woman who's laughing?
lines.es: La verdad es que no. ¿Quién es la mujer que se está riendo?

lines.t: That's my sister-in-law. She's the one who made the cake.
lines.es: Es mi cuñada. Es la que ha hecho la tarta.

lines.t: The chocolate cake which is on the table? It's amazing!
lines.es: ¿La tarta de chocolate que está en la mesa? ¡Está buenísima!

lines.t: I know! And the man next to her is a neighbour.
lines.es: ¡Ya lo sé! Y el hombre que está a su lado es un vecino.

lines.t: The one who lent you the barbecue?
lines.es: ¿El que os ha prestado la barbacoa?

lines.t: Exactly. He's a kind man who helps everybody.
lines.es: Exacto. Es un hombre amable que ayuda a todo el mundo.

lines.t: Your friends are lovely. I feel at home here.
lines.es: Tus amigos son encantadores. Me siento como en casa.

realLife.t: Who's the woman who's talking to your husband?
realLife.es: ¿Quién es la mujer que está hablando con tu marido?
realLife.context: Para preguntar quién es alguien en una fiesta o una boda

summary: who → personas: a friend who lives in Leeds
which → cosas: the scarf which she knitted
No repitas el sujeto: the man who works (no «who he works»)
